[package]
name = "librespot"
version = "0.8.0"
rust-version = "1.85"
authors = ["Librespot Org"]
license = "MIT"
description = "An open source client library for Spotify, with support for Spotify Connect"
keywords = ["audio", "spotify", "music", "streaming", "connect"]
categories = ["multimedia::audio"]
repository = "https://github.com/librespot-org/librespot"
readme = "README.md"
edition = "2024"
include = ["src/**/*", "audio/**/*", "connect/**/*", "core/**/*", "discovery/**/*", "examples/**/*", "metadata/**/*", "oauth/**/*", "playback/**/*", "protocol/**/*", "Cargo.toml", "README.md", "LICENSE", "COMPILING.md", "CONTRIBUTING.md"]

[package.metadata.deb]
maintainer = "Librespot Organization <noreply@github.com>"
copyright = "2015, Paul Liétar"
license-file = ["LICENSE", "4"]
depends = "$auto"
recommends = "avahi-daemon"
extended-description = "librespot is an open source client library for Spotify. It enables applications to use Spotify's service to control and play music via various backends, and to act as a Spotify Connect receiver. It is an alternative to the official and now deprecated closed-source libspotify. Additionally, it provides extra features which are not available in the official library.\n.\nThis package provides the librespot binary for headless Spotify Connect playback. .\nNote: librespot only works with Spotify Premium accounts."
section = "sound"
priority = "optional"
assets = [["target/release/librespot", "usr/bin/", "755"], ["README.md", "usr/share/doc/librespot/", "644"], ["contrib/librespot.service", "lib/systemd/system/", "644"], ["contrib/librespot.user.service", "lib/systemd/user/", "644"]]

[workspace.package]
rust-version = "1.85"
authors = ["Librespot Org"]
license = "MIT"
repository = "https://github.com/librespot-org/librespot"
edition = "2024"

[workspace.dependencies.librespot-audio]
version = "0.8.0"
path = "audio"
default-features = false

[workspace.dependencies.librespot-connect]
version = "0.8.0"
path = "connect"
default-features = false

[workspace.dependencies.librespot-core]
version = "0.8.0"
path = "core"
default-features = false

[workspace.dependencies.librespot-discovery]
version = "0.8.0"
path = "discovery"
default-features = false

[workspace.dependencies.librespot-metadata]
version = "0.8.0"
path = "metadata"
default-features = false

[workspace.dependencies.librespot-oauth]
version = "0.8.0"
path = "oauth"
default-features = false

[workspace.dependencies.librespot-playback]
version = "0.8.0"
path = "playback"
default-features = false

[workspace.dependencies.librespot-protocol]
version = "0.8.0"
path = "protocol"
default-features = false

[workspace.lints.clippy]
redundant_closure_for_method_calls = "warn"

[features]
default = ["native-tls", "rodio-backend", "with-libmdns"]
native-tls = ["librespot-core/native-tls", "librespot-oauth/native-tls"]
rustls-tls-native-roots = ["librespot-core/rustls-tls-native-roots", "librespot-oauth/rustls-tls-native-roots"]
rustls-tls-webpki-roots = ["librespot-core/rustls-tls-webpki-roots", "librespot-oauth/rustls-tls-webpki-roots"]
rodio-backend = ["librespot-playback/rodio-backend"]
rodiojack-backend = ["librespot-playback/rodiojack-backend"]
gstreamer-backend = ["librespot-playback/gstreamer-backend"]
portaudio-backend = ["librespot-playback/portaudio-backend"]
sdl-backend = ["librespot-playback/sdl-backend"]
alsa-backend = ["librespot-playback/alsa-backend"]
pulseaudio-backend = ["librespot-playback/pulseaudio-backend"]
jackaudio-backend = ["librespot-playback/jackaudio-backend"]
with-libmdns = ["librespot-discovery/with-libmdns"]
with-avahi = ["librespot-discovery/with-avahi"]
with-dns-sd = ["librespot-discovery/with-dns-sd"]
passthrough-decoder = ["librespot-playback/passthrough-decoder"]

[lib]
name = "librespot"
path = "src/lib.rs"

[[bin]]
name = "librespot"
path = "src/main.rs"
doc = false

[dependencies]
data-encoding = "2.5"
getopts = "0.2"
log = "0.4"
sha1 = "0.10"
thiserror = "2"
url = "2.2"

[dependencies.librespot-audio]
version = "0.8.0"
path = "audio"
default-features = false

[dependencies.librespot-connect]
version = "0.8.0"
path = "connect"
default-features = false

[dependencies.librespot-core]
version = "0.8.0"
path = "core"
default-features = false

[dependencies.librespot-discovery]
version = "0.8.0"
path = "discovery"
default-features = false

[dependencies.librespot-metadata]
version = "0.8.0"
path = "metadata"
default-features = false

[dependencies.librespot-oauth]
version = "0.8.0"
path = "oauth"
default-features = false

[dependencies.librespot-playback]
version = "0.8.0"
path = "playback"
default-features = false

[dependencies.librespot-protocol]
version = "0.8.0"
path = "protocol"
default-features = false

[dependencies.env_logger]
version = "0.11.2"
default-features = false
features = ["color", "humantime", "auto-color"]

[dependencies.futures-util]
version = "0.3"
default-features = false

[dependencies.sysinfo]
version = "0.36"
default-features = false
features = ["system"]

[dependencies.tokio]
version = "1"
features = ["rt", "macros", "signal", "sync", "process"]

[lints.clippy]
redundant_closure_for_method_calls = "warn"

[package]
name = "librespot-audio"
version = "0.8.0"
rust-version = "1.85"
authors = ["Paul Lietar <paul@lietar.net>"]

[dependencies.futures-util]

[dependencies.hyper]
version = "1.6"
features = ["http1", "http2"]

[dependencies.hyper-util]

[features]

rustls-tls-webpki-roots = ["librespot-core/rustls-tls-webpki-roots"]

[dependencies]
log = "0.4"
protobuf = "3.7"
serde_json = "1.0"
thiserror = "2"

[dependencies.librespot-core]
version = "0.8.0"
path = "../core"
default-features = false

[dependencies.librespot-playback]
version = "0.8.0"
path = "../playback"

[dependencies.librespot-protocol]
version = "0.8.0"
path = "../protocol"
default-features = false

[dependencies.futures-util]
version = "0.3"
default-features = false
features = ["std"]

[dependencies.rand]
version = "0.9"
default-features = false
features = ["small_rng"]

[dependencies.tokio]
version = "1"
features = ["macros", "sync"]

[dependencies.tokio-stream]
version = "0.1"
default-features = false

[dependencies.uuid]
version = "1.18"

[lints.clippy]

[package]
name = "librespot-core"
version = "0.8.0"
rust-version = "1.85"
authors = ["Paul Lietar <paul@lietar.net>"]
license = "MIT"
description = "The core functionality provided by librespot"
repository = "https://github.com/librespot-org/librespot"
edition = "2024"
build = "build.rs"

[features]
default = ["native-tls"]
native-tls = ["dep:hyper-tls", "hyper-proxy2/tls", "librespot-oauth/native-tls", "tokio-tungstenite/native-tls"]
rustls-tls-native-roots = ["__rustls", "hyper-proxy2/rustls", "hyper-rustls/native-tokio", "librespot-oauth/rustls-tls-native-roots", "tokio-tungstenite/rustls-tls-native-roots"]
rustls-tls-webpki-roots = ["__rustls", "hyper-proxy2/rustls-webpki", "hyper-rustls/webpki-tokio", "librespot-oauth/rustls-tls-webpki-roots", "tokio-tungstenite/rustls-tls-webpki-roots"]
__rustls = []

[dependencies]
aes = "0.8"
base64 = "0.22"
byteorder = "1.5"
bytes = "1"
data-encoding = "2.9"
flate2 = "1.1"
form_urlencoded = "1.2"
futures-core = "0.3"
hmac = "0.12"
httparse = "1.10"
http = "1.3"
http-body-util = "0.1"
log = "0.4"
nonzero_ext = "0.3"
num-bigint = "0.4"
num-derive = "0.4"
num-integer = "0.1"
num-traits = "0.2"
pin-project-lite = "0.2"
priority-queue = "2.5"
protobuf = "3.7"
protobuf-json-mapping = "3.7"
rsa = "0.9"
serde_json = "1.0"
shannon = "0.2"
thiserror = "2"
url = "2"

[dependencies.librespot-oauth]
version = "0.8.0"
path = "../oauth"
default-features = false

[dependencies.librespot-protocol]
version = "0.8.0"
path = "../protocol"
default-features = false

[dependencies.futures-util]
version = "0.3"
default-features = false
features = ["alloc", "bilock", "unstable"]

[dependencies.governor]
version = "0.10"
default-features = false
features = ["std"]

[dependencies.hyper]
version = "1.6"
features = ["http1", "http2"]

[dependencies.hyper-proxy2]
version = "0.1"
default-features = false

[dependencies.hyper-rustls]
version = "0.27"
default-features = false
features = ["http1", "http2", "ring"]
optional = true

[dependencies.hyper-tls]
version = "0.6"
optional = true

[dependencies.hyper-util]

default-features = false
features = ["client", "http1", "http2"]

[dependencies.pbkdf2]
version = "0.12"
default-features = false
features = ["hmac"]

[dependencies.quick-xml]
version = "0.38"
features = ["serialize"]

[dependencies.rand]
version = "0.9"
default-features = false
features = ["thread_rng"]

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1.0"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.sha1]
version = "0.10"
features = ["oid"]

[dependencies.sysinfo]
version = "0.36"
default-features = false
features = ["system"]

[dependencies.time]
version = "0.3"
features = ["formatting", "parsing"]

[dependencies.tokio]
version = "1"
features = ["io-util", "macros", "net", "rt", "sync", "time"]

[dependencies.tokio-stream]
version = "0.1"
default-features = false

[dependencies.tokio-tungstenite]
version = "0.28"
default-features = false

[dependencies.tokio-util]
version = "0.7"
default-features = false

[dependencies.uuid]
version = "1"
default-features = false
features = ["v4"]

[build-dependencies]
rand_distr = "0.5"
vergen = "=9.0.6"

[build-dependencies.rand]
version = "0.9"

[build-dependencies.vergen-gitcl]
version = "1.0.8"

features = ["build"]

[dev-dependencies.tokio]
version = "1"
features = ["macros"]

[lints.clippy]
redundant_closure_for_method_calls = "warn"

http-body-util = "0.1"
log = "0.4"

serde_json = "1.0"
sha1 = "0.10"
thiserror = "2"

[dependencies.librespot-core]
version = "0.8.0"
path = "../core"
default-features = false

[dependencies.dns-sd]
version = "0.1"
optional = true

[dependencies.futures-util]
version = "0.3"
default-features = false
features = ["std"]

[dependencies.hyper]
version = "1.6"

[dependencies.hyper-util]

[dependencies.libmdns]

[features]

native-tls = ["oauth2/native-tls", "reqwest/native-tls"]

[dev-dependencies.tokio]

features = ["rt-multi-thread", "macros"]

[dependencies.rand]
